summary: Section 64 — First Steps onboarding panel: backend 16/16 pass, frontend flows verified (F4-F11 + regressions). One integration bug confirmed in MediaChooser Upload-mode (PUT /providers/me rejects partial body with 422).

minor.issue: Pydantic model ProviderProfileIn requires business_name + category_id (no defaults). Sending only {logo_url} or {banner_url} returns 422. This breaks MediaChooser Upload-mode flow which posts only the new URL after /upload.

integration_issues.issue: After /upload returns a file URL, the chooser does PUT /providers/me with {[logo_url|banner_url]: url} only — backend returns 422 because business_name and category_id are required. AI save path works fine (uses /providers/me/save-ai-image which writes directly to DB).

verified_working.F2_save_ai_image: Saves to /api/files/..., updates logo_url/banner_url on profile, role-gated to provider, target validated
verified_working.F3_existing_endpoints: generate-banner OK, /upload multipart OK, PUT /providers/me OK when required fields included
verified_working.F4_smart_action_first_steps_card: Renders for provider at top with 'Activate your eCard (4/6)'. DEDUP confirmed: complete-profile + add-gallery-photos cards HIDDEN.
verified_working.F5_panel: Opens with header, progress bar, 6 step cards (logo/bio/banner/gallery/share/review), skip footer button. Completed steps show check icon + line-through.
verified_working.F6_step_click_behavior: Clicking DONE logo step does NOT open MediaChooser (correctly disabled). Pending steps navigate.
verified_working.F10_skip_persistence: Skip writes timestamp to localStorage key 'gtm_first_steps_skipped_until' (e.g., 1782462401345). After skip, first-steps nudge hidden in SmartActionHub.
verified_working.F11_hidden_contexts: Hub hidden on /login, /verificar-correo, and /admin (for admin user). Visible on /, /search, /comunidad, /dashboard/provider.
verified_working.role_gating: Client role: hub shown but first-steps card NOT shown (correct). Admin role: hub hidden on /admin (correct).
verified_working.regression_share_url: /services/{slug} redirects to /p/{slug} confirmed. /api/providers/by-slug returns provider with slug field.

untested: F7/F8 AI generate→preview→Use this end-to-end via UI (demo provider has logo+banner already done so MediaChooser is never reached for those steps in the current panel state). Backend pipeline is fully covered by tests.
F9 Upload mode via UI (same reason — chooser not reachable without un-setting demo data). Bug confirmed at API level.
action_items: Fix PUT /providers/me to accept partial updates OR change MediaChooser Upload flow to include business_name + category_id in the PUT body (or use /providers/me/save-ai-image-style endpoint for uploaded files too).
Optional: have demo.provider start with logo/banner UNSET so MediaChooser is reachable for QA testing of F7-F9 flows via UI.
critical_code_review_comments: ProviderProfileIn requires business_name and category_id; many partial-update flows in the FE will silently 422. Recommend making fields Optional[str] = None on PUT or splitting into ProviderProfileCreate vs ProviderProfilePatch.
data-testid='first-steps-progress' element exists but has no visible text content — the '4 / 6 complete' label is rendered on a different element. Consider moving the testid or adding aria-valuenow.
Dev mode shows uncaught axios 401 rejections as React error overlay on first load (before login). Not a blocker but noisy; consider catching auth/me 401 silently in the AuthContext.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all observable flows pass; MediaChooser interior flows could not be opened due to demo data already complete

test_credentials: demo.provider@getamano.com / provider123 (provider, 4/6 first-steps done); demo.client@getamano.com / client123; admin@getamano.com / admin123. Use page.evaluate fetch with credentials:'include' for cookie-based auth — Playwright UI form submit was flaky due to dev-mode error overlay.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests restore prev logo_url/banner_url and clear localStorage skip key after each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If E1 fixes the PUT /providers/me partial-update bug, retest MediaChooser Upload mode by either (a) clearing logo_url on demo.provider via DB to make logo step pending, or (b) registering a fresh provider. Backend tests in test_iter62_first_steps_logo_ai.py are reusable; the test_put_providers_me_partial_logo_url_known_bug expects 422 — update to 200 after the fix.
rca_of_the_issue: MediaChooser Upload flow: const uploaded = await api.post('/upload', form); await api.put('/providers/me', { [field]: uploaded.url });  →  backend ProviderProfileIn requires business_name + category_id  →  422. The AI flow works because it uses a dedicated /providers/me/save-ai-image endpoint that writes directly to the providers collection without going through ProviderProfileIn.
